newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank repo average rate rises to 18.02 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank repo average rate rises to 18.02 pct.

text.p: Average yield in a Slovak central bank (NBS) one-week repo tender on Monday rose to 18.02 percent from 15.55 percent in a similar repo last Wednesday, the NBS said.
The NBS offered 2.0 billion crowns and bids totalled 7.419 billion crowns. The minimum accepted rate was 18.00 percent, while the maximum rate was 18.15 percent.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of August 3 exceeded the volume of minimum reserves requirements by 0.70 percent.
